Re-evaluate the generation: Maria Josepha is the paternal grandmother of Marie Zéphyrine, while Maria Leszczyńska is the maternal grandmother.

The analysis states the Planner 'falsely concluded she [Maria Josepha] was his [Louis's] mother' but then immediately claims 'Maria Josepha of Saxony is actually her [Marie Zéphyrine's] paternal grandmother's role'. This is logically impossible; if Maria Josepha is Louis's spouse, she is the mother of Marie Zéphyrine, not her grandmother. Furthermore, the analysis incorrectly identifies the paternal grandmother as Maria Leszczyńska (who was actually the wife of Louis XV and thus the maternal grandmother of Marie Zéphyrine). The actual error in Turn 6 is the confusion between the roles of the parents' parents (confusing maternal grandmother for paternal grandmother), but the 'error analysis' text itself is hallucinated and internally inconsistent regarding who holds which title.
